CTA.TITLE: The community is waiting for you

HERO.DESC: It doesn't matter if your friends are in the same city or across the world. Madnolia creates a direct tunnel so your game thinks everyone is connected to the same physical switch in the room.

STEPS.TITLE: Online LAN matches without technicalities
STEPS.DESC: Three simple steps. Zero network configuration.

STEP1.TITLE: Turn on the Switch
STEP1.DESC: When creating your game room, simply toggle the "Enable LAN" button. Madnolia provisions a private network tunnel instantly.

STEP2.TITLE: Direct Connection
STEP2.DESC: Your friends join the room and Madnolia establishes a direct IP. We use the WireGuard® protocol, the most modern technology for P2P connections, ensuring ultra-fast data transfer, perfect stability, and zero lag.

STEP3.TITLE: Copy, paste, and play
STEP3.DESC: You will be assigned a simulated local IP. Press "Start LAN", copy the IP, and share it with your friends.

CTA.TITLE: Don't let distance ruin the match.
CTA.DESC: Create your own local network in seconds and focus just on playing.

HEADER.TITLE: Team up instantly in any LAN game.
HEADER.DESC: Relive the golden age of Local Area Network (LAN) gaming without touching your router configuration.

COMPATIBILITY.TITLE: Compatible with your favorite classics
COMPATIBILITY.DESC: Our infrastructure works at the OS level. If your game or emulator has a "Local Network" (LAN) mode, it will work.
